FUNCTIONAL executes named frozen scenarios through the actual native command boundary. Protect dirty input for all navigation/cancel/create/restore/close paths, retain invalid/rejected/uncertain input and communicate pending/close waiting without false success. Viewing remains usable while admitted work runs; all rows remain keyboard/VoiceOver reachable at capacity.

Named controls/field associations/status announcements, contained modal focus and meaningful return, visible unobscured focus, fixed shipped light-appearance contrast across all relevant states (including under OS dark appearance) and Rust View Text size100/150/200plus shortcuts reflow at1280x720. Actual human VoiceOver, keyboard and contrast/200percent evidence is mandatory; AX/DOM alone is not sufficient.

Consume bundled local help resource supplied by T020 at final compilation; source authoring does not require its prose. P1/P2/P3 timings are full delivered-package budgets, not optimistic first-frame or domain-only timings.

reuse.capability_missing: No task views, editor or accessible dialog implementation exists.

candidates.reason: Only navigation; empty roots are not pages/components and no existing UI owns this interaction.
Frozen messages and service signatures carry shape only; modifying generated code would duplicate invariant ownership and violate the freeze.
ProbeProvider proves generated invoke/ACL feasibility with synthetic Turso data and out-of-scope stub methods; it is pinned qualification evidence, not reusable Todo production behavior.

reuse.why_not_extend: No existing application owner implements this capability. Add files only inside the already approved logical owner; retain three application compilation units, reuse the generated traits and approved dependencies, and do not create a parallel service framework. The minimal T001 entry scaffold remains separately owned by T010.
reuse.duplication_check: Searched apps/, modules/, tests/acceptance/, tests/integration/, benchmarks/ plus generated traits and qualification probe providers by operation, SQL, validation and lifecycle symbols. Only navigational README files exist under application/test roots. All invariant validation stays in Collection, SQL in Storage, file publication in Backup and admission in Application.

tasks.title: Write bundled offline help and user backup compatibility guide
acceptance: Document all FR025 topics, complete task/date/query/pending/retry behavior, actual per-account data location, unencrypted selected backups, replace-not-merge restore, permanent deletion/no undo and earlier backups retaining deleted tasks. Display actual Cargo-derived version at runtime; do not hardcode a fictional release identity.

Explain exact version1 backup/storage compatibility and future-format rejection; no previous-release migration is applicable. Verify help is bundled and available without network/development tooling through LIFECYCLE/C-PACKAGE/OFFLINE.

tasks.title: Document reproducible build verification dependencies and revision evidence handoff
acceptance: Replace boilerplate navigation with actual target ownership and verified exact-version clean build/package/sign/install/verification commands, prerequisites, licenses/dependency purposes and release resource identity. Preserve harness workflow directions and immutable frozen documents.

Handoff links current controller check/raw evidence, actual delivered .app digest and clean-build observer transcript for all53Must IDs; distinguish instrumentation/delivered package and report reference-host limitations. Link the controller-generated final project validation only once it exists; do not fabricate it in a tracked document or create a circular requirement for that future artifact inside C-HANDOFF.

Complete all cumulative P01 checks, actual human/platform records, independent exact-source phase review and one ready verified PR before seal. Final gate project and checkpoint/export are controller lifecycle work; no merging/deployment is included.

Before phase gating, run/import all prerequisite checks at the final committed revision, then run C-HANDOFF and retain its validated pre-gate report. Phase/project gates may rerun it safely against the same source and existing upstream records; final validation is a distinct controller artifact after seal. Stable tracked links avoid report creation changing its own source digest.

Populate docs/dependency-inventory.md with the actual dependency inventory and required third-party notices/license attribution, and verify T010 bundles that exact resource in the delivered .app. Preserve required upstream notices rather than merely listing dependency names.

verticals.goal: Durable task lifecycle from real boundary assertions through native storage and final handoff
Exact independent query oracle through invariant owner and Rust UI
Selected-file backup validation/publication and atomic replacement
Account-scoped single owner with ready window and local help
Private failure-independent diagnostics in restricted desktop composition
Capacity and external performance observer through accessible pending UI
Direct native input oracles through approved production command restriction
